---
title: Cellosaurus
description: Cellosaurus cell lines, their cross-references and donor diseases, from the flat-file release.
---

[Cellosaurus](https://www.cellosaurus.org) is the cell-line registry: one
entry per line, each with a stable `CVCL_` accession, and the glue between
CELLxGENE, ENCODE biosamples, BEDbase, GEO and DepMap, which all name cell
lines differently. The release lands `cellosaurus.txt` whole, one row per
line of the file, and derives three tables from it: the cell line, its
cross-references (DR lines) and the donor diseases (DI lines). The version
is the file's own header (`Version: 56.0`).

## Licence and citation

CC BY 4.0: "Cellosaurus © CALIPHO group, SIB Swiss Institute of
Bioinformatics". Cite the release version as `provenance.release` records it
and [the Cellosaurus paper](https://www.cellosaurus.org/description.html).

## Join keys

- `annotation.cellosaurus__cell_line.accession` is the `CVCL_` id; `__xref` and `__disease` join on it.
- A cell line can have more than one species (hybridomas and hybrid lines), so `taxon_ids` is a sorted list, not a scalar.
- Cross-references are their own table rather than rows in `annotation.identifier_mapping`: a cell line is not a gene, and a third of the DR lines point at Wikidata.

## Good to know

- Comments (CC), STR profiles (ST), references (RX) and web links (WW) are in raw and not derived.
- OI lines (same individual) stay in raw.
- `cellosaurus_refs.txt`, `cellosaurus_xrefs.txt` and the deleted-accessions file are not landed.
